typography.guidelines: Use 'Anton' for massive, brutalist, condensed hero headings and numbers (like rankings). Use 'Unbounded' for secondary headings and badges to give a wide, tech-meets-street feel. Use 'Manrope' for highly readable body text, inputs, and UI elements. Avoid Gloock and Outfit entirely.

colors.guidelines: Dark asphalt base (#0A0A0C) with high-contrast electric lime and violet accents. Never use pure black or gray; always tint towards a cool, deep asphalt. Accent colors should be used for interactions, badges, and to emulate neon glows.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with a very subtle white border (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) and semi-transparent background (rgba(18,18,20,0.6)) for sticky navs and floating elements. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glows: Apply soft box-shadows matching the accent colors (e.g., lime or violet) for active states and critical CTAs to mimic neon signs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise/grain overlays on hero sections to emulate asphalt or concrete. Use subtle spray-paint/drip decorative elements sparingly (perhaps as a background mask on the hero).
visual_enhancers.corners: Mix sharp corners (0px radius) for main layout containers to reflect brutalist/gallery styles, and slightly rounded corners (8px) for interactive elements like buttons and badges.

components.nav_bar: Sticky, glassy header (backdrop-blur-xl) with solid text contrast. Must include the 'Art Core' wordmark (styled in Anton, brutalist condensed).
components.buttons: Sharp corners or slight radius (4px). Primary buttons use Neon Lime background with Dark Asphalt text. Hover state: slight scale up and glow.
components.cards: For the marketplace and portfolio, use flat surfaces with 1px subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)). On hover, lift the card and increase border opacity or tint to an accent color.
components.coming_soon_stubs: For Auctions, Commissions, Events, Gamification: Treat with premium intentionality. Use a dark, blurry overlay with a neon 'Coming Soon' badge or a metallic lock icon.
components.feed: Instagram-style stories rail at the top (circular artist avatars with neon gradients). Explore feed uses a Behance-style masonry or Bento grid.

grids_and_layouts.explore_feed: Bento grid or masonry layout to accommodate different artwork aspect ratios. Use gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Generous spacing (py-24 or py-32). Massive 'Anton' heading, with a subtle parallax artwork background.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use Tailwind spacing scale generously. Sections should have pt-20 pb-20 minimum to feel like a high-end gallery.

motion.guidelines: Framer Motion feel. Springy hover states for buttons (scale 1.02). Staggered fade-ins (opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0) for the explore feed grid. Parallax scroll on the hero background.
motion.stats: Animated number counters for likes, followers, and bids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Hover states must increase visibility. Focus rings should use the Neon Lime accent.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='explore-artwork-card'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebrand context: 'House of Monster' is now 'Art Core'. Remove all traces of Gloock/Outfit fonts and magenta/yellow/pink/blue themes.
Use a dark, moody 'asphalt' background (#0A0A0C) with high energy neon lime and violet elements to mimic the 'graffiti on asphalt' vibe.
The wordmark 'Art Core' should be massive and brutalist (use Anton font).
Integrate Framer Motion for premium feel: parallax hero scrolling, springy hovers, and staggered grid reveals.
Implement the 'coming soon' stubs (Auctions, Commissions, Events, Gamification) thoughtfully, using a glassy overlay and a premium 'Coming Soon' neon badge.
Follow the 'Bento' grid structure for the explore page, avoiding simple equal squares.
Ensure the design feels like a billion-dollar luxury platform that embraces street culture.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
